title: Due diligence on a strategy
objectives: Compare at least two or three strategies using APMI data.
Judge track record after fees and in falls.
body_md:
A PMS recommendation rests on documented due diligence and a fee illustration the client has seen in rupees, not percentages.

## Due diligence on a strategy

| Area | What to check |
|---|---|
| Track record | After-fee returns vs benchmark over 3, 5 and 7 years, including how it did in falls such as 2020 and 2022 |
| Manager & team | Who runs the money, how long they have, and what happens if they leave |
| Process | Stock-selection approach and style (growth, value, quality, momentum) and whether it has stayed consistent |
| Portfolio | Number of stocks, top-10 weight, sector and market-cap concentration, cash calls |
| Risk | Worst drawdown, volatility, recovery time |
| Costs | Full fee structure, exit load, and expected brokerage and churn |
| Comparison | At least two or three strategies in the same category, using APMI-published data |
example: You compare three multi-cap strategies on after-fee returns over 3, 5 and 7 years and on how each fell in 2020 and 2022. The fund with a slightly lower return but a shallower fall is a better fit for a cautious client.
say: Here's how this manager did in the 2020 and 2022 falls.
I'm showing you three strategies side by side, not just one.
never: This one gave 60% last year, so choose it.
There is no need to compare.

check.q: Which is the most important track-record check in PMS due diligence?
o: After-fee returns vs benchmark over 3, 5 and 7 years, including falls
Number of clients the PMS has
check.why: Include how the strategy did in falls such as 2020 and 2022.

check.q: How many strategies should you compare before recommending one?
o: At least two or three in the same category
check.why: Compare at least two or three strategies in the same category using APMI-published data.

check.q: Which return figure should you use in due diligence?
check.why: After-fee returns versus the benchmark over 3, 5 and 7 years give a fair picture.
